recognize_zh: 黏膜下被一片瀰漫、單一形態的中型單核細胞完全佔據，殘存的小圓形腺體/血管結構被包埋在其中，細胞間有散在嗜酸性細胞質的細胞；這種破壞性、非淋巴球樣的浸潤要想到骨髓性肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma），需以 MPO/CD34/CD117 等免疫染色確認。
features: Dense, diffuse sheet-like infiltrate effacing the mucosal stroma
Monotonous intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio
Round to irregular hyperchromatic nuclei; cells appear discohesive
Scattered cells with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm admixed
Small round residual glandular/vascular structures entrapped within the infiltrate
Focal fibrous stroma with streaming of cells at the periphery
describe_en: Sections of sinonasal mucosa show a dense, diffuse infiltrate of mononuclear cells that effaces the lamina propria and entraps small residual round glandular/vascular structures. At higher magnification within this field, the cells are intermediate in size with high N:C ratios, irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant to moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, and they grow in a discohesive pattern. No surface epithelium or granulomas are evident in this field. The appearance of a destructive, monotonous infiltrate is suggestive of a hematolymphoid neoplasm; in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (MPO, CD34, CD117, lysozyme positivity) the findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, lack admixed eosinophilic myeloid precursors, and are CD20+/MPO-negative.
NK/T-cell lymphoma shows angiocentric growth with zonal necrosis and is CD56+, cytoplasmic CD3+ and EBER-positive rather than MPO-positive.

ddx.dx: Olfactory neuroblastoma / small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma forms lobules with neurofibrillary matrix and Homer Wright rosettes and is synaptophysin/chromogranin-positive and CD45-negative.
Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous with small lymphocytes, plasma cells and neutrophils and do not form a monotonous destructive sheet of immature cells.
